llr: single focal masked logP(ALT)-logP(REF), mean forward and reverse-complement scores; explicit CLS offset, no pad or truncation; raw strand scores preserved
comparison: same genomic bases/positions as PlantCAD2; Botanic model-specific CLS token added

rules.botanic_abs: 0.8 conventional annotation baseline + 0.2 within-locus percentile(abs(raw LLR)) at each context
rules.botanic_signed_512: exploratory: 0.8 same baseline + 0.2 within-locus percentile(signed raw REF-to-ALT LLR), fixed before Botanic score inspection

alpha_aggregation: mean(abs(log1p(ALT)-log1p(REF))) across output bins overlapping central 2048 genomic bases and all fixed RNA_SEQ tracks; exact bin boundaries required; forward genomic sequence; identical flanks
alpha_smoke: public TAIR10 sequence around first separate fixture, no pilot SNPs
endpoint: same frozen held-out association lead, p<.05/full-locus candidate count; target and threshold do not change with coverage
bootstrap: 2000 draws whole chromosomes, seed20261114; descriptive only
